title: Why Your Stomach Growls in Quiet Libraries
caption:
Your stomach growls because it's mopping itself clean!
A quiet library study session gets hijacked by a giant GRRGROON - his stomach roars, and a cartoon stomach grabs a broom to sweep inside.
That growl is the migrating motor complex: fasting waves sweep leftover debris through your empty gut roughly every 90 minutes.
Has your stomach ever embarrassed you in a totally silent room?
Save this for the next time your gut goes loud!
